Dashboards

Dashboards, plain HTML.

Six application demos with different layouts and workflows. Explore analytics, sales, team administration, account management, commerce and customer support. Built with semantic HTML, Colibri CSS and browser modules.

Analytics

KPIs with sparklines, traffic area chart with range switch, source donut, customers table, weekly bars + goal meter.

CRM

A wide sales workspace with horizontal navigation, editable deal cards and a board-first pipeline.

Team workspace

Light sidebar, a welcome mosaic, team directory, member roles and a working meeting agenda.

Account center

Horizontal navigation and feature cards for profile, security, billing and member management.

Commerce

A store operations desk with order details, fulfillment status, inventory and CSV export.

Support desk

A focused queue and conversation layout with assignment, status changes and saved replies.

Theme packs: themes/packs/ · <html data-kit-theme="glacier|ember|midnight"> · try ?theme=midnight. Source on GitHub.
